title: Drag chats to unpin
summary: A pinned item can be dragged out of the rail's Pinned group; while it is outside, a 'Release to unpin' tooltip follows the cursor, and on release the item returns to its home group (here Routines).

steps.shows: 'Plan launch timeline' being dragged (grabbed cursor, lifted row with hover bg and 3-dot) over the Routines group with a dark tooltip 'Release to unpin'.
steps.changedFrom: Start of journey; the dragged row floats over Routines and the Pinned slot it left is filled by a highlighted row.
steps.action: Press and drag the pinned chat 'Plan launch timeline' down out of the Pinned group.
components: Copilot desktop Input Box {Type=Landing Page, State=Default, Tools & Sources=No, Text=Placeholder, Attachment=No}

steps.shows: After release: Pinned now holds Artifacts, Project Name, Review customer feedback; 'Plan launch timeline' sits second in Routines with hover background and 3-dot.
steps.changedFrom: Pinned group shrinks by one row; the item is inserted into Routines; tooltip and grab cursor gone (pointer hand).
steps.action: Release the mouse outside the Pinned group.
components: Copilot desktop Input Box {Type=Landing Page, State=Default, Tools & Sources=No, Text=Placeholder, Attachment=No}

openQuestions: Step 01 shows 'Review customer feedback' twice in Pinned (one highlighted at the vacated slot). Is the highlighted slot meant to be an empty drop placeholder?
Unpinned item lands in Routines, i.e. its home group, not where it was dropped. Confirm the rule (return to home group, sorted by recency?).
Where exactly does 'Release to unpin' start: as soon as the cursor leaves the Pinned group bounds?
